findings.claim: MSFT FY2026 10-K 自述：AI 市場競爭激烈且有新進入者持續加入，AI 產品與超大規模雲商、開源及前沿模型供應商競爭（部分同時是夥伴）；多數業務進入門檻低。
findings.excerpt: AI technology and services are a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market, and new competitors continue to enter the market. Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers, open-source offerings, and frontier model providers, some of which are also current or potential partners.

findings.claim: Synergy 資料：2025Q3 AWS 29%、Microsoft 20%、Google 13% 雲支出份額
findings.source: The Register, AWS under pressure as big three battle to eat the cloud market
findings.excerpt: AWS still has a comfortable lead, with 29 percent of global market spend in Q3, but Microsoft and Google, the junior pair in the cloud triumvirate, are steadily increasing their market shares, accounting for 20 percent and 13 percent respectively.

findings.claim: Ramp 資料：Anthropic 企業支出份額 37% 對 OpenAI 33%，資料集不含 Microsoft
findings.source: Sherwood News, Microsoft is pushing Copilot but everyone just wants ChatGPT

findings.claim: Microsoft 在 365 Copilot 加入 Anthropic 模型，降低對 OpenAI 依賴

competitive_share_entrants.note: WebSearch 摘要僅得二手聚合站數字（Synergy 雲份額：AWS約28%、Azure約21%、Google Cloud由14%升至15%，Azure大致持平；Anthropic 企業 AI 支出/用量份額上升；Copilot 消費端份額下滑報導），來源品質混雜、無可逐字複製原文，故只放 clues。 線索 3 條，程式核實 1 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
